$comment: Route map for Indus. Coordinates are normalised (0-1) against a landscape screen so they survive a change of device resolution. Re-recorded by hand on 2026-08-18 against com.indusgame.play 2.14.0 on a vivo I2217 (2400x1080). Every coordinate below was tapped and confirmed on the device in that session unless marked inherited. Prose notes explain WHY, so a later pass can tell a deliberate choice from a stale guess.

app.name: Indus
app.$buildStamp: The lobby and every settings screen print a footer at the very bottom: 'v2.14.0 #11451000 (11451000) | SID : FAUPEHGM | B : A | India (b:in) | T : <epoch>'. Read it at the start of a run and record it with the findings — it is the only in-app statement of which build, which account and which region were actually scanned. Region there (India) is the billing/content region and is independent of the UI language.

capabilities.$comment: Confirmed again on 2.14.0: `uiautomator dump` returns zero text nodes because Unity draws the whole UI into one SurfaceView. Every string must be read from pixels, on dev, staging and prod alike. Consequence: lib/checks.js (which needs exact strings + rects from the bridge) contributes nothing on this title, and the vision pass carries the entire load. Budget effort accordingly — do not assume the cheap deterministic layer caught the mechanical defects, because it never ran.

techniques.$comment: How to actually get the strings out of this game. Each of these was the difference between seeing one string and seeing dozens; a crawler that only screenshots each screen once misses most of the text in the build.
techniques.gridDetailPanels: Inventory and Abilities are grids that drive a detail panel. Selecting a cell replaces the name, the lore/description and sometimes a stat block on the right. The grid holds dozens of items and only the selected one's text is on screen, so every cell in every category and every tab has to be tapped. Confirmed: avatar cell 1 showed 'BRUNO PLAYHARD / From a mobile gaming channel to the top of the world...', cell 2 showed 'ADI SERIES / Customizable Avatar. Parts can be switched with other series...'. Screenshotting the grid once would have captured one of them.
techniques.rowDescriptionPanels: Settings > Gameplay lists option rows on the right and shows a description for the SELECTED row only, in a panel at lower left. Tapping a different row swaps that text. Confirmed: 'Auto Sprint' showed 'Enables continuous sprinting when moving forward...' and 'Cosmium Trigger' showed 'Tap the button to interact with Cosmium.'. Every row must be selected to read its description.
techniques.infoBadgeFlyouts: Small circled '?' chips sit next to some labels. Tapping one opens a flyout that is not reachable any other way and that OVERLAPS the text beneath it. Confirmed on Abilities: the '?' beside the ability name opened a 'HOW TO USE' panel with three lines ('Equip this ability from loadout', 'Press the button in game to use it', 'Once used it enters cooldown') covering the ability description. Capture the screen before opening the badge and again after, then dismiss it, or the occluded strings are lost.
techniques.scrollMomentumSettle: Scrollable lists keep moving after the swipe ends. Tapping a target located in a screenshot taken right after a swipe hits the wrong row. This cost three misfires in the language picker: aiming at PORTUGUESE (BRAZIL) selected GERMAN, then SPANISH (MEXICO). The rule: after any swipe, capture two screenshots ~2s apart and compare them; only when they are identical is the list settled. Then re-locate the target by reading the fresh screenshot, never from the pre-scroll one.
techniques.stickyTabs: Settings reopens on whichever tab was last used, not on General. Do not assume the landing tab — read the highlighted rail entry and navigate from what is actually on screen.
techniques.englishBaseline: The strongest overflow and truncation findings come from capturing the same screen twice, once in English and once in the target language, and comparing the rendered text extents. 'SEASON ENDED' cleared the season banner with ~40% space to spare; 'TEMPORADA TERMINADA' ran under the character artwork to the card's right edge. Neither screenshot alone proves a defect — the pair does. Capture an English baseline pass first whenever the budget allows.

recovery.$comment: EC-70001 'LOST CONNECTION' can strand the app on a modal that RETRY does not clear. A force-stop and relaunch reliably recovers it; observed on dev 1.12.0, not reproduced on prod 2.14.0.

blocked.$comment: Never tap these. They spend money, sign in or out, destroy settings, or drop the scan into a live match it cannot get out of. Matched against the control labels below.

lobby.$comment: The hub. Bottom rail opens the four collections; the left stack holds Missions and Ranked; the right rail is promotional cards that rotate on a carousel, so two captures of the lobby will not always match.

settings.$comment: One screen with a fixed left rail; the tab decides the right pane. The rail's Reset and Exit buttons sit at the bottom and are both destructive. Settings reopens on the last-used tab.

settings.general.$comment: Toggle rows. Scrolls — more rows exist below 'Emote'.

settings.gameplay.$comment: Sub-tabs across the top, option rows on the right, and a description panel at lower left that only ever shows the SELECTED row's text. See techniques.rowDescriptionPanels.

rowDetails.$comment: Tap each; read descriptionPanel after every tap.

settings.languagePicker.$comment: A modal with a SCROLLING list — the old fixed per-language coordinates from the 2026-08-11 map were wrong and have been removed. Entries must be located by reading the current screenshot after the list has settled. See techniques.scrollMomentumSettle.

entries.$comment: Complete list as shipped in 2.14.0, top to bottom, enumerated by scrolling the modal end to end on 2026-08-18. 15 entries. ARABIC IS NOT PRESENT — it was in 1.12.0 and has since been removed, which retires the old arabicTofu concern. Every entry is written in ENGLISH rather than as an endonym; see knownFindings.languageNamesNotEndonyms.

inventory.$comment: Five categories down the left, a secondary icon rail, then a scrolling grid. Selecting a cell fills the detail panel on the right with that item's name and lore. See techniques.gridDetailPanels.

abilities.$comment: Three tabs (Active/Auto/Passive), an OWNED grid and an OBTAIN ABILITIES grid, each cell driving a full detail page: name, tagline, EFFECT tag, description, a stat block with units, and a warning line. Stat values carry units ('90s', '6s', '150%') worth checking for locale number formatting.

promoInterstitial.$comment: A promotional interstitial may cover the lobby after launch. Close it before driving any lobby coordinate.

missions.$comment: Category rail on the left, a scrolling list of mission rows on the right, each with its own progress counter and an IR/GO button. The mission text is generated from templates with a count substituted in, which is where the pluralisation defects live — read every row, not just the first screenful.

ranked.$comment: Reached from the lobby's RANQUEADAS button. Between seasons the panes are empty and the sub-tabs render greyed out — an empty pane here is the game's state, not a failed capture, so do not report the missing text as a defect.

store.$comment: The most commercially visible text in the build. Seven categories down the left, each its own catalogue of priced items. Prices follow the account REGION (₹ for India) and not the UI language — see checkHints.currencyFollowsRegion. Never tap a purchase confirm.

weapons.$comment: ARMAS is not a screen — it opens a modal chooser over the dimmed lobby with three cards. Each card leads to a deeper collection. A crawler that treats this as a leaf screen records three words and stops.

anyText: Tem certeza de que deseja sair do jogo
Are you sure you want to exit

exitConfirm.$comment: HAZARD. Android BACK pressed on the lobby opens this confirmation, and its SIM/YES button quits the app and ends the scan. A crawler that uses back to navigate up WILL reach it. Always answer with cancel.

autoDismiss.$comment: Dismiss on sight; never treat SIM/YES as an explorable control.

setLanguage.$comment: Language is per ACCOUNT, not per device locale — the device stays on India/English and changing it has no effect. Takes ~15s to apply and returns to the SETTINGS screen (not the lobby), still on the Account tab. Re-verified 2026-08-18.

steps.$comment: Read the checkbox back before confirming. Three separate mis-taps selected the wrong language during recording because the list was still gliding.

knownIssues.$comment: Confirmed with the team as known and accepted. Per the 2026-08-18 decision these are still REPORTED, but tagged known:true at the lowest severity and collapsed by default, so the list stays honest without them competing with new findings.

settingsLanguageLeak.note: Switching the account language does not fully re-render the Settings screen: a subset of keys keeps rendering in the PREVIOUSLY selected language. Confirmed on 2.14.0 with the account set to English — the screen showed SUPORTE, MUDAR (x2), SAIR DO JOGO, CONFIGURAÇÕES BÁSICAS, REDEFINIR CONFIGURAÇÕES, SELECIONE O IDIOMA, 'Entrar com o Play Games' and 'Entrar com o Google' in Portuguese while every other string was English. Switching to Portuguese rendered all of them correctly, which proves these are not missing translations — it is a refresh bug. The 2026-08-11 French pass hit the same keys (CHANGEMENT, SORTIE DU JEU, SOUTIEN), so it is the same key set every time.
settingsLanguageLeak.$stillReport: Anything in Settings that is NOT in matchAny is a new defect and must be reported normally.

arabicTofu.note: RETIRED. Arabic rendered as tofu boxes in 1.12.0 because the glyph atlas was missing. Arabic is no longer offered at all in 2.14.0 — the language picker was enumerated end to end on 2026-08-18 and holds 15 entries, none of them Arabic. There is nothing left to test or suppress; kept only so a reader of the 2026-08-11 notes knows what happened to it.

launchPromo.note: A promotional interstitial may cover the lobby after launch. Close it via screens.promoInterstitial.close before driving any lobby coordinates. This is a navigation obstacle, not a localization finding.

knownFindings.$comment: Real defects confirmed by hand on 2026-08-18, prod 2.14.0, Portuguese (Brazil). Recorded so a scan can be graded: a run that misses these has a coverage problem, and a run that reports them agrees with a human. These are NOT suppressed.

linguagemVsIdioma.detail: Settings > Conta labels the language row 'Linguagem', but the picker it opens is titled 'SELECIONE O IDIOMA'. Two different words for the same concept, two taps apart. pt-BR UI convention is 'Idioma'; 'Linguagem' reads as language-as-faculty or a programming language. Fix the label, not the picker.
linguagemVsIdioma.teaches: Terminology consistency has to be checked ACROSS screens, not only within one screen. The label and the thing it opens are the classic pair to compare.

untranslatedValues.detail: With the UI in pt-BR the row labels translate (Região, Linguagem) but their VALUES stay English: 'Portuguese (Brazil)' should be 'Português (Brasil)' and 'India' should be 'Índia'. The 2026-08-11 French pass found the identical pattern ('French', 'India'), so it is systemic, not a one-off.
untranslatedValues.teaches: Check the value half of a label/value row separately. A screen can look fully translated while every value on it is still English.

languageNamesNotEndonyms.detail: Every entry in the language picker is written in English (ENGLISH, FRENCH, RUSSIAN, GERMAN, ITALIAN, SPANISH (SPAIN), PORTUGUESE (BRAZIL)...) regardless of the UI language. A language picker is the one screen that should always use endonyms — Français, Русский, Deutsch, Português (Brasil) — because a player who cannot read the current language has to find their own.
languageNamesNotEndonyms.teaches: A language picker is a special case: its entries should NOT match the target-language column, they should each be in their own language.

seasonBannerOverflowPt.detail: The season card subtitle. English 'SEASON ENDED' ends with roughly 40% of the card clear; pt-BR 'TEMPORADA TERMINADA' is ~73% wider, runs under the character artwork and reaches the card's right edge. Not hard-truncated on this device, but it has no margin left and a narrower screen or a longer locale will clip it.
seasonBannerOverflowPt.teaches: Proven by comparing the English and pt-BR captures of the same card. See techniques.englishBaseline.

mixedBrandStrings.detail: Half-translated promo card: 'Pacote' is Portuguese, 'LOUD Classics' is English. Likely correct if 'LOUD Classics' is a product name, but it needs an explicit decision rather than being left ambiguous.
mixedBrandStrings.teaches: Flag mixed-language strings even when the English half may be an intentional brand name — ask, do not silently pass.

missionPluralAgreement.string: Obtenha 1 tiros na cabeça em uma partida
missionPluralAgreement.detail: Mission text substitutes a count into a template that is fixed in the plural: '1 tiros' pairs a singular number with a plural noun. Correct pt-BR is '1 tiro'. Every mission row is built the same way, so any objective that can reach a count of 1 reads wrong.
missionPluralAgreement.teaches: Counted strings are the highest-yield place to look for grammar defects. Read the NUMBER and the NOUN together and check agreement — a template that hard-codes the plural is invisible until the count happens to be 1.

claimVerbInconsistency.detail: The same action is 'RESGATAR' on the lobby's claim chip and 'REIVINDIQUE' on the missions screen's claim-all button. Two verbs for one concept, one screen apart. pt-BR convention favours 'Resgatar'.
claimVerbInconsistency.teaches: Same class as linguagemVsIdioma: build a glossary of recurring UI verbs across screens and flag a concept rendered two ways.

bundleStoreUntranslated.detail: In the Store's category rail every sibling is Portuguese — Destaques, Ofertas, Gemas, Loja Prismática, Loja de Resgate, Código de Criador — and 'Bundle Store' alone is English. It is not a brand name; the neighbouring 'Loja Prismática' and 'Loja de Resgate' prove the pattern is 'Loja de ...'.
bundleStoreUntranslated.teaches: A single English item inside an otherwise translated LIST is the strongest possible untranslated signal. Compare each entry against its siblings, not only against the sheet.

rankedLabelVsTitle.detail: The lobby button reads RANQUEADAS; the screen it opens is titled CLASSIFICAÇÃO. May be deliberate (ranked matches vs standings) — confirm against the English pair before reporting as a defect.
rankedLabelVsTitle.teaches: When a button and its destination title disagree, capture the English pair before calling it a defect: the source may make the same distinction.

checkHints.$comment: Things this app does that change how a string should be compared against the sheet. Learned on-device, not assumed.
checkHints.inlineMarkup: Descriptions carry inline rich-text markup — the Gameplay description renders 'Tap' in amber and the rest in white, i.e. the source string contains colour tags. Strip markup from both sides before comparing to the sheet, and never report the tag itself as a stray placeholder.
checkHints.quotedUiReferences: Descriptions quote other UI labels, e.g. the ADI SERIES avatar says 'Click "Customize"'. The quoted label must match the actual button's text IN THE SAME LOCALE. A description translated while the button it names was not (or the reverse) is a real defect and only shows up if you compare the two.
checkHints.currencyFollowsRegion: Prices render as Indian rupees (₹29.00) because the account region is India, while the UI language is Portuguese. That is correct — currency follows the account region, not the language. Do not report a currency/language mismatch as a defect; DO report a currency that does not match the region in the build stamp.
checkHints.unitSuffixes: Ability stats render as '90s', '6s', '150%'. Check the separator and unit placement against locale convention rather than assuming the English form is right.
checkHints.playerContent: The lobby carries a live chat line and player names (e.g. 'CrimsonEyE : all', 'InventiveAggressor'). These are user content, never localized, and must not be compared against the sheet.

hazards.$comment: States a crawl can put itself into that end or derail the run. Each was hit by hand during recording.
hazards.backOnLobbyExits: Android BACK on the lobby opens the exit-game confirmation (screens.exitConfirm). Hit during recording: a back-press intended to close the Weapons modal fell through to the lobby and opened it, and three subsequent taps landed on the dialog instead of the intended screen. Prefer the in-screen back chevron at [0.035, 0.076] over KEYCODE_BACK, and after any back-press check for the exitConfirm signature before tapping anything else.
hazards.modalSwallowsTaps: While any modal is open every coordinate from the underlying screen is wrong. After an unexpected modal appears, re-identify the screen from a fresh capture rather than continuing the planned tap sequence.
